To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a three-body approach is essential in the lowest partial wave in η-deuteron reactions and in coherent and inelastic photoproduction of η mesons off the deuteron in the near-thres-hold region.

a three-body approach to η–deuteren reactions and η photoproduction off the deuteron is mandatory in the low-energy region, and that the ηNN-interaction is essential in order to explain the observed data.

the ηNN interaction in the three-body approach is essential for the understanding of the η photoproduction data and that the ηN interaction in the final state is important only in the higher partial waves.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the role of the ηN interaction in the low-energy ηN system.
the role of the ηN and ηNN interaction in the low-energy η–deutero reaction and in the η photoproduction off the deuteron.
the study of η photoproduc-tion on the deuteron in a low-energy region.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the three-body approach is indispensable for a quantitative understanding of the ηNN system.
the three-body model with a separable ηN interaction is a very promising and successful approach for the description of the ηNN system.
the ηNN system at low energy is a three-body problem.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a three-body approach is essential for a consistent description of η photoproduc-tion and η–deuteration in a low-energy regime.
the ηNN-interaction in the low-energy region can be described within a three-body framework.
the ηNN interaction has to be included at low energies in a realistic way in the three-body approach to describe the data of η photodisintegration of the deuteron.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the η–deutero interaction is not negligible and should not be ignored.
a consistent description of the experimental data can be obtained only if the ηNN interaction in the final state is taken into account.

the ηN final-state interaction is not sufficient to explain the experimental data, and that a three-body treatment with a strong ηNN force is necessary to describe η photoproduction and the η-deuteron reactions in the near-threhold region.
